title: Product FAQ Accordion Functional Repair & Interaction Regression

root_cause.location: inline <script> block after </section> on every locale product page (NOT the .faq-item text content, NOT the inline onclick attribute)
root_cause.defect: click-handler if/else branches setting max-height were reversed relative to the correct (English root) logic
root_cause.mechanism: two click listeners per question (inline onclick toggles .open class + aria-expanded; a second addEventListener sets max-height based on .open) -- inline handler fires first, so by the time the second listener reads .open it already reflects the post-toggle state, and its branches must map open->show, which they did not on locale pages
root_cause.verified_uniform: exactly one byte-identical buggy variant across all 830 locale files; exactly one byte-identical correct variant across all 83 applicable English root files

scope.shared_code_impact: none -- faq.html uses native <details>/<summary>; contact.html uses a different .faq-qt/.faq-qi structure with no matching click handler; calculators and header.html contain zero .faq-q/.faq-a occurrences (confirmed by direct search)

fix.method: single-line swap of the two branch bodies, applied identically to how the English root pages already do it

regression_test_proof.step1: ran against fixed pages -- PASS on all 11 languages
regression_test_proof.step2: deliberately reintroduced the inverted script on ar/1121-basmati-rice-exporter.html only
regression_test_proof.step3: re-ran browser test -- FAIL, isolated to ar: 'expected open state after click, got height=0 (scrollHeight=74) aria=true'

keyboard_interaction.tab_focus: lands on .faq-q, visible 3px solid focus outline
keyboard_interaction.note: existing onkeydown handler (Enter/Space -> click()) was not modified; it now works correctly because the underlying click handler is fixed

multi_open_behavior.model: multi-open (opening one question does not close another)
multi_open_behavior.verified: opened items 1 and 3 of 5; both remained open independently

out_of_scope_discovery.title: 4 products (psyllium-husk-exporter.html, sugar-s30-supplier.html, indian-raisins-kishmish-exporter.html, yellow-peas-matar-exporter.html) have a bespoke non-interactive English FAQ while their locale pages carry the generic interactive accordion
out_of_scope_discovery.caused_by_phase_7: partially -- Phase 7's generator regenerated locale FAQ content wherever 5 stale .faq-item elements already existed, without checking whether the English root had since diverged to bespoke content for these 4 products
out_of_scope_discovery.verified_not_a_phase_8_defect: all 3 (excluding sugar-s30, which has no locale FAQ at all) tested directly and their locale accordions open/close correctly with this phase's fix
out_of_scope_discovery.action_taken: documented only, not fixed -- content-parity decision outside this phase's authorized scope
